refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `SilikoFunctionCallerNew` function creates a new `SilikoFunctionCaller` object.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: Unless there is a memory error, `SilikoFunctionCallerNew` returns a pointer to the new object. If there is a memory error, `SilikoFunctionCallerNew` returns `NULL`. If `SilikoFunctionCallerNew` returns a pointer to an object, it must be deleted with `SilikoFunctionCallerDelete`.
